summary: 87 features and 44 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • monospec-icons: resolve configured and default repository icons (e146f9c)
  • openspec-prompts: apply design guidance to fast-forward flow (f36de97)
  • session-notifications: publish proposal task progress (af0956e)
  • session-steering: expose delivery state in message payloads (a4b9d58)
  • copilot: send chat images through vision models (bf31dc9)
  • session-steering: route follow-ups into active Claude runs (dbdf4b0)
  • copilot: route interactive questions through session flow (4adac25)
  • agent-cli-presets: expose Copilot question capability (6965e54)
  • opencode: send chat images inline to vision models (3f2345b)
  • agent-cli: expose preset-declared capabilities (042e7be)
  • scheduled-plans: support recurring occurrence changes (c74759a)
  • scheduled-plans: add calendar projections and safe plan updates (2df54ad)
  • frontend-config: add Turbo Engine startup splash settings (bf344bc)
  • orleans: forward agent work snapshots from executor grains (80a5f9e)
  • ai-streaming: emit agent work snapshots from CLI providers (e1a49c9)
  • opencode: support interactive questions during CLI runs (9df1ec3)
  • hero-catalog: add GPT 6.0 Astra to secondary presets (2da14d2)
  • openspec: add structured stage result formats to prompts (4c6368b)
  • frontend-config: persist the font ligatures preference (f6758ed)
  • openspec: expose task counts in proposal responses (c96e547)
  • scheduled-plans: add background manual plan runs (4246c35)
  • scheduled-plans: schedule proposal and HagiTask sessions (501d545)

HagiCode-org/web

  • pwa: cache images with bounded sheet-specific policies (0dca02a)
  • monospecs: edit repository icons in management settings (9850acd)
  • cat-icons: show repository cats and rotate the built-in brand (6d4c4cb)
  • achievement: populate the achievement icon atlas (7bc730d)
  • session-progress: animate checklist ring updates (9c47a9d)
  • session: assign deterministic cat portraits to sessions (49c92b7)
  • project-icons: replace game icons with cat portraits (ea17cc3)
  • conversation: make Send or Steer the running-session default (518fe95)
  • conversation: link local paths to Code Server by platform (ba5c56e)
  • achievement: render drawer icons from a shared atlas (8f8bb51)
  • mobile: optimize proposal and task creation drawers (a7ef2b2)
  • session: close archived drawers and adapt phone details (3d97350)
  • drawer: add phone back-button and swipe dismissal (2db275a)
  • i18n: translate phone drawer and proposal flow labels (02145b5)
  • hero-avatar: load built-in avatars from series assets (26b7ad5)
  • hero-avatar: render built-in avatars from shared sprite sheets (2a90697)
  • hero-avatar-series: generate validated multi-size sheets (f945f8d)
  • session-progress: show checklist progress as a circular ring (7a83e7f)
  • hero-gallery: virtualize large avatar group browsers (c99efb0)
  • session-stow: fold created drawers into session cards (14d5b06)
  • session-favicon: show artwork for each running count (1a72a97)
  • session-notifications: show proposal task progress in the list (0152426)
  • openspec-viewer: structure and fold artifact documents (0ff79c8)
  • conversation: fuse Send and Steer into one control (17da405)
  • startup-splash: cache and expand the boot artwork (9947737)
  • conversation: add Claude CLI message steering controls (b50ebaa)
  • conversation: animate newly arriving transcript entries (52d3e25)
  • responsive-ui: compact phone chrome and conversation composer (7a0d013)
  • question-card: mark explicit rejections in submitted answers (a0d1c52)
  • agent-cli: add GitHub Copilot interactive control (72c08d9)
  • mobile-chat: add a compact composer and drawer exit (3ed3f7c)
  • responsive-ui: adapt shell and workflows to phone and tablet (3fee29d)
  • scheduled-plans: lock occurrence edits to one run (e27debb)
  • super-commit: style structured commit results (b687c33)
  • token-monitor: show illustrations on milestone cards (013aad1)
  • agent-cli: add stable cat avatars and capability indicators (336d082)
  • scheduled-plans: edit or delete one recurring occurrence (e2d04a8)
  • theme-backgrounds: add anime scene generator (f4fcd25)
  • scheduled-plans: add calendar views for scheduled occurrences (b862c1d)
  • hero: animate scenario roster transfers and live previews (97e7206)
  • startup-splash: configure boot artwork and selection modes (559c268)
  • hero: show agent CLI marks on group headers (d898467)
  • hero: add OpenCode provider and timeout fields (d4c5924)
  • splash: open the loading shell onto the mounted app (835ab08)
  • tabs: show task progress on the Tasks tab (38710c3)
  • splash: load 155 AVIF splash artworks from a glob (71d8898)
  • theme: serve built-in backgrounds as AVIF (69560f9)
  • statusbar: extend TokenMonitor through its crown tiers (2965e6e)
  • settings: add OpenCode to interactive control settings (ea697d1)
  • achievement: animate unlocks and the achievement hall (1576322)
  • settings: add a frontend font ligatures preference (6e59bfc)
  • creation: improve task setup and readiness checklists (c9d8bfa)
  • proposal: animate stage progress and streamline plan setup (c48d102)
  • kanban: add finite motion cues to workflow lanes (5f6e456)
  • conversation: render structured prompt and result sections (0a28b8f)
  • creation: show required content across creation drawers (bcae46d)
  • hero: replace equipment slots with a guided loadout deck (d9156be)
  • openspec: show task progress in proposal tabs (0108b6c)
  • scheduled-plans: add presets and plan mode to creation flows (04461e4)
  • statusbar: animate token milestones with progress cues (9da87c3)
  • conversation: render structured final response sections (b1350a3)
  • git: rename AI commit actions to Super Commit (7aded6e)
  • statusbar: show agent readiness counts and state changes (df6d427)
  • settings: add a master-detail document theme picker (5f7738a)
  • scheduled-plans: add recurring proposal and HagiTask plans (efbc5e6)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • copilot: decline rejected interactive answers (3344ea0)
  • prompts: forbid Copilot questions in non-interactive runs (ed6a25a)
  • openspec-prompts: align localized workflows with CLI contract (27d43b7)
  • auto-compose-commit: require a structured result block (dabae95)
  • opencode: normalize configured model provider values (842e710)
  • opencode: qualify bare models with the configured provider (7f6c993)
  • web: serve AVIF theme backgrounds with the correct media type (42a6a66)
  • prompts: forbid OpenCode question tools in automated prompts (b2a3918)
  • opencode: support authenticated OpenCode 2.0 session flows (a41c177)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session-background: scale images to the container width (6b752d6)
  • session-background: fit images to their natural size (d9ff935)
  • conversation: keep local path text selectable (5c65438)
  • boot-splash: prevent page scroll while loading shell is shown (c2efd9a)
  • proposal-viewer: hide duplicated artifact file headers (cc64114)
  • conversation: hide the empty-draft steering hint (1f0046a)
  • token-monitor: animate milestone and achievement exits (1853360)
  • git: refresh requested status before auto-commit (326b39b)
  • kanban: keep repository details outside the clipped panel (1336fd4)
  • wizard: narrow selected values with an explicit type guard (724bb0b)
  • hero: remove CLI summaries and show provider source labels (f24069b)
  • hero: use the inventory key for blocked model guidance (48956fa)
  • ui: let callers size the shared dialog surface (d8a8e4d)
  • git: close project details after automatic AI commits (bceca7f)
  • proposals: keep repository cards stable when hover ends (7412641)
  • templates: preserve character template scope types (6afbcfa)
  • projects: preserve scope and launch descriptor types (c19ae33)
  • ui: narrow nullable values across shared components (a0ffa02)
  • i18n: preserve default values in namespaced translations (3e93aa9)
  • monitoring: align health and concurrency status DTOs (7552be8)
  • git: normalize commit results and retry actions (30cf35e)
  • preset-tasks: normalize task fields and gallery results (f8cb36f)
  • settings: preserve partial and legacy settings values (01be969)
  • notifications: reset idle deadlines from latest summaries (b852e26)
  • quick-actions: append new actions after existing entries (b4b04b9)
  • skills: preserve gallery detail and update metadata (0b7ad2b)
  • proposals: normalize validation and repository selections (7a56794)
  • sessions: preserve selection across list layouts (1aaf992)
  • conversation: guard session input and normalize rendering (e287da1)
  • hero: normalize avatar data and nullable selections (bae98f9)
  • projects: guard IDs across project selection and actions (fe53a98)
  • api: normalize optional values at service boundaries (c2584e8)
  • signalr: model session IDs as serialized strings (10c0876)
  • icons: filter curated names through icon validation (41722e6)
  • types: load app declarations and browser timer handles (7d641e6)
